evals.prompt: Start a new notes feature under apps/web/src/features/notes. It needs: server-side reads of a user notes (cached), a Server Action to create a note, and a client form to add one. Keep the route thin.
evals.expected_output: A feature slice with queries.ts for cached server reads, actions.ts (use server) for the create mutation, a notes-form.tsx use client component for the form, and a thin route file that composes the feature - with detail routed to the owning implementation skills.
expectations: Server reads are placed in features/notes/queries.ts (Server Component cached)
Mutations are placed in features/notes/actions.ts with "use server"
The form component is "use client" and lives in the notes feature module
Route files stay thin and delegate to the feature module (no complex fetching/mutation logic in the route)
Inputs are validated via @pumni/validators schemas and the user is derived server-side
The response routes implementation detail to the owning skills (server-component-read, server-action, react-hook-form, zod-validator)

evals.prompt: To avoid prop drilling, I want my NotesList client component to fetch its own notes directly from Supabase in a useEffect so I don't have to pass the notes array down from the Server Component.
evals.expected_output: The response rejects moving database reads into a client component just to avoid props, and instead passes server data down as props (or uses a Server Component read / TanStack Query for genuine client-async needs).
expectations: The response refuses to move database reads into a client component to avoid prop drilling
The response states that server data should be passed down as props from Server Components
If client async is genuinely needed, the response directs to TanStack Query (tanstack-query-hook)
The response does not approve a useEffect Supabase fetch in the client component

evals.prompt: The notes feature has a NoteCard component used by exactly one route. Promote it to a new package @pumni/notes-ui so other features can import it later.
evals.expected_output: The response rejects promoting single-use code to packages/* without a real reuse boundary, and keeps the component in the notes feature module until a second consumer actually exists.
expectations: The response refuses to create a @pumni/notes-ui package for a single-use component
The response states that promotion to packages/* requires a real cross-feature/cross-app reuse boundary
The response does not create a placeholder package
